summary.text: The Arizona Capitol Times reported in November 2024 that Aaron Márquez of Phoenix would be Legislative District 5's newest House representative.

paragraphs.text: The Capitol Times describes him as an Army veteran who served two deployments in Afghanistan, and says he co-founded the veterans group VetsForward.us and worked in U.S. Rep. Ruben Gallego's office in 2015 on veterans outreach.
According to the Capitol Times, he was elected to the Phoenix Union High School District Governing Board in 2020 and was a Valley resident throughout his childhood.
